atelier.title: The Philosophy
atelier.subtitle:
"Uncompromising Standards,
Proven Masterpiece."
atelier.desc1: <1>LUMIÈRE</1> is not just a construction brokerage platform. We are a private collection of Korea's top-tier PPF ateliers gathered under the single philosophy of 'perfection'.
atelier.desc2:
Among countless films on the market, we strictly select and use only <1>High-End Grade Films whose physical properties, gloss, and durability have been perfectly verified. The strict standards that do not allow even a single small bubble or minute finishing error
are the promise Lumière makes to you.
atelier.desc3: Starting with <1>high-end studios in the metropolitan area</1>, we carefully select and list <2>Master Ateliers across the country</2> that possess unrivaled technology and craftsmanship. Not just anyone can be registered, and only those proven by their skills can use the name of Lumière.
atelier.desc4:
We also propose a <1>premium technical solution for the engine and powertrain, the heart of the vehicle, beyond the beauty of the exterior. Through persistent diagnosis and precise maintenance by master mechanics who perfectly understand the mechanism of supercars and luxury sedans,
we manage your vehicle so that it can maintain the performance of the moment it was first designed for a long time.
atelier.desc5:
Beyond simply protecting the car, so that your asset value can shine forever.
LUMIÈRE proposes the best curation for your vehicle.

process.title: The Process
process.subtitle:
A Persistent Journey
Towards Perfection
process.description: LUMIÈRE adheres to uncompromising processes for the essential protection and aesthetic perfection of the paintwork.
process.step1_desc: We devote as much time as others, or even more, solely to one vehicle. This is not because we are slow. It is because we focus on details that do not allow even a single fine foreign substance, perfectly rolling into the invisible finish. LUMIÈRE does not compromise on quality to meet delivery times.
process.step2_desc: We never use films with strong adhesive or irritating adhesion promoters for immediate easy construction and strong initial adhesion. This gives convenience to the installer, but can cause irreversible damage to the paint surface. We insist only on genuine films that provide the safest and purest protection to the paint surface, even if the construction process is difficult.
process.step3_title: Craftsmanship Thinking of the Moment of Removal
process.step3_desc: The true value of PPF is proven not only by protection from contamination and accidents but also when the film is removed years later. To keep the gloss of the new car alive without damaging the paint when the film is peeled off. That is LUMIÈRE's craftsmanship and promise that thinks from beginning to end.
